title: Resolve payer provider references without identity shortcuts
objective: Rate samples can identify the declared provider groups within the same file context.
outcome: Scope provider-group/reference IDs to the reporting file/version. Equal numeric reference IDs in different files cannot be joined accidentally. A missing referenced object yields an unresolved association; no provider group is invented from a hospital name. An NPI-bearing rate does not automatically map to a hospital CCN or a complete facility roster. Reference closure has explicit count and byte limits. Source-local reference resolution never performs an implicit cross-source identity merge. Ledger-named packages/identity/mrf/ is not used because identity is WP7-sealed. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Model inline and external references
commits.instructions: Scope provider-group/reference IDs to the reporting file/version and preserve NPI/TIN type/value as documented. External references are separate bounded resources.
commits.verification: Equal numeric reference IDs in different files cannot be joined accidentally.

commits.subject: Resolve bounded reference closures
commits.instructions: Fetch/parse only the required declared reference objects under source budgets; detect missing references and cycles without unbounded expansion.
commits.verification: A missing referenced object yields an unresolved association; no provider group is invented from a hospital name.

commits.subject: Expose reference completeness
commits.instructions: Attach resolved/unresolved group counts, context and evidence to the rate sample. Keep facility mapping a separate qualified join.
